name: Winsome Yarns Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, Winsome Yarns Ltd manufactures Yarn and knitwear and does generation of power[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
WYL is part of the Winsome Group which 
 deals in textiles, yarns, breweries, warehousing, energy, minerals & mining, telecom, trading, etc. Co. manufactures a variety of products like Melange, Organic, Dyed, and Blended Yarn

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -47.7% over past five years.
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 95.0% of their holding.
Debtor days have increased from 58.5 to 105 days.
